newsitem.title: USA: Phonetel to buy Communications Central.
newsitem.headline: Phonetel to buy Communications Central.

text.p: PhoneTel Technologies Inc said on Friday it signed a definitive agreement to buy Communications Central Inc for $165 million in cash and assumed debt.
PhoneTel said it would buy all of Communications Central's outstanding shares for $12.85 apiece. Communications Central was trading at 9-1/2 Friday afternoon, up 5/8 on the day.

Both companies are independent pay-phone operators. PhoneTell, based in Cleveland, has 41,300 installed public pay phones. Communications Central, of Roswell, Ga., has 26,000 pay phones and inmate phones.
